description: This Java abstract class manages transport activity sessions, including session state updates, expiration handling, and activity reporting within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TransportActivityManager
classes.description: Abstract class managing transport session activities, including session expiration, state updates, and activity reporting.

methods.name: getReportingPeriodMillis
methods.description: Returns the reporting period in milliseconds based on session report timeout.

methods.name: getStrategy
methods.description: Returns the activity strategy based on configured reporting strategy type.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the activity state with session info, handling gateway sessions and overwrite activity time logic.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Determines if a session has expired based on last recorded activity time.

methods.name: onStateExpiry
methods.description: Handles session expiration, removing session, deregistering, and notifying remote session close.

methods.name: reportActivity
methods.description: Reports activity for a session, updating subscription info and invoking callback on success or failure.

methods.name: getCurrentTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the current system time in milliseconds.
